material_updates.topic: Nanjing Medical University English MBBS 2026 baseline
material_updates.finding: Official 2026 guide lists application fee CNY 500, nonrefundable post-pre-admission deposit CNY 13,000, tuition CNY 34,000/year, insurance CNY 600/year, accommodation CNY 6,000–8,000/year; IELTS 6.0 min 5 each or alternatives; CSCA Math and Chemistry mandatory; GPA >=3.0/4 equivalent; full-tuition scholarship CNY 34,000 does not cover living; 2027 unconfirmed.

material_updates.topic: HKU 2027 MBBS affordability and Belt Road
material_updates.finding: Official 2027 application fee HKD 780; 2027/28 nonlocal MBBS tuition HKD 590,000/year; current Belt Road description states full nonlocal tuition for successful awardees, Kazakhstan eligible, but 2027 terms subject to modification and living/hostel/insurance coverage unverified.
Use GPA 4.65/5.0 and only EndoSim as owned project; exclude AngioSim and other unverified STEM projects.
